notes.title: Version 0.6.7
notes.content: Revised translations, added the achievement 'eye spy with my little cuck', updated professor meeting conditions and quest timings (including 'greg check back inside apartment' and 'weird girlfriend quest'), and fixed various text issues (including removal of hard-coded names, corrections to Greek text, adjustments to bull phone text, and explicit phrase fixes).

notes.title: The day has finally come….
notes.content:
[b]The day has finally come…. 🐓[/b]

Hello everyone,

First, let me say a huge [b]thank you[/b] to each and every one of you for supporting the dream that is CuckTales. It’s been almost a year of development, and your encouragement has kept me going—even through moments where I wasn’t always consistent. I truly appreciate every single one of you for sticking around and believing in this project.

[hr]

[b]Release Date & Steam Reviews[/b]
Mark your calendars: [b]CuckTales[/b] is set to launch on [b]March 5th[/b]! Once the game is live:
• If you’re a paid Patreon member and would like a Steam key, simply message me.
• If you’d prefer to buy directly on Steam, that’s awesome too. Either way, please leave a positive review so we can reach 25 reviews quickly. Every review helps boost visibility!

[hr]

[b]Wishlist Count & Goal[/b]
Currently, we’ve reached [b]5,056 wishlists[/b]—that’s amazing! Our goal is [b]6,000 wishlists[/b] by launch, so we need [b]944 more[/b]. Every wishlist truly matters for the game’s initial visibility. Please help us hit that target by wishlisting here:

[i]https://store.steampowered.com/app/3030240/CuckTales/[/i]

With your help, I know we can make it happen!

[hr]

[b]What’s Left to Do[/b]
As we approach release day, here’s the final to-do list:

Finish the Story
Reach 6,000 Wishlists (before launch)
Add More Minigames
Add Random Dialog Between Characters
Translate to Other Languages & Implement Language Changer
Add Ejaculation Scene
Final Bug Wrap-Up
Fix the Gallery
Post Final Build
Final Announcements
Upload Game on DLSite
Add Steam Achievements
Translate Steam Page to Other Languages
[hr]

[b]Future Plans[/b]
After [b]CuckTales 🐓[/b] launches, I’m planning to go full-time as a developer and begin working on our next game, [b]BullTales 🦬[/b]. This couldn’t happen without your continued support and enthusiasm, so I want you to know how grateful I am.

[hr]

[b]A Heartfelt Thank You[/b]
Your support means the world to me. Please:
• [b]Wishlist[/b] the game if you haven’t already (we’re so close to 6,000!).
• On launch day ([b]March 5th[/b]), grab the game and leave a [b]review[/b] on Steam.
• Stay tuned for final announcements as we wrap up the last pieces of development.

Thank you once again for being the driving force behind this project. I’m excited for what’s next and can’t wait to share [b]CuckTales[/b] with you all!

[hr]

[b]With gratitude,[/b]
[i]Your Dev[/i]
